primary_task: Test whether a compiled cryptographic implementation is constant-time using a dudect statistical harness, with Timecop/Valgrind for root-causing leaks.

requirements.name: C compiler
requirements.evidence: Write dudect harness for the crypto function ... timeout 600 ./ct_test

requirements.name: valgrind
requirements.evidence: Timecop wraps Valgrind ... If leaks found - Use Timecop

notes: Valgrind/Timecop phase is conditional on dudect finding a leak; available anyway. github.com root returned HTTP 403 (not a tunnel refusal) but raw.githubusercontent.com download of dudect.h returned 200. Timing measurements in a shared container are noisy but runnable.
